correctness.rationale: Exact linear change of coordinates in characteristic five gives a cone over a (2,3) projective complete intersection. Six distinct F5 directions indexed by affine classes of all residue permutations exhaust Bezout degree six, so the scheme is reduced. The nonzero conic determinant and coprimality of q2,q3 establish the regular sequence. The Hilbert series yields evaluation ranks 1,3,5,6 and delta 9. No coordinate evaluation basis vector lies in degrees 1 or 2, while degree >=3 is surjective, proving conductor t_i^3 on every branch. Normalization exact sequence for global units eliminates 5 constant parameters; truncated log mod t_i^3 (valid in char 5) identifies the remaining four-dimensional group with Ga^4. The bundled stdlib checker verifies all critical finite identities; algebraic-closure completeness comes from Bezout and the proof, not field sampling.

value.rationale: A distinguished wild prime of a canonical highly symmetric genus-four curve acquires an exactly classifiable six-line fiber. The component orbit, six-branch singular local ring, conductor, delta invariant, and purely additive Picard group give a complete motivic degeneration profile in one specified arithmetic model. In particular, Pic0=Ga^4 is not recoverable from the number of rational components or classical complex Jacobian data without the local-conductor computation.
